_doc: APPROVED CONTENT OVERRIDE for SS-2026-35 (SS Weekly visual-system recovery, 2026-09-20; expanded to 18 products 2026-09-20). The calendar-driven generic path could not express: (1) an exact required product order (300KG Panel Cart Trolley - id 858 - first, the product featured in the hero banner), (2) a THEME-LEVEL (not exact-category) product selection reaching exactly 18 relevant products, (3) per-product factual descriptions instead of the repeated category label, (4) a hero that carries the full campaign message so no separate text headline/intro/CTA duplicates it below the hero image. The Campaign Calendar (Lark) remains the planning source and is untouched by this file. All 18 products are fetched live and verified by id at generation time (never fabricated).
_product_discovery_note: The verified BigCommerce 'Platform Trolley' category (id 133) has exactly 9 real, visible, in-stock products (694, 695, 696, 785, 786, 787, 788, 857, 858) - Tier 1, all included. No hand trucks/sack trucks/drum trolleys/dollies exist anywhere in this catalog (exhaustive keyword search). A broader keyword search (dolly/bin/stock/load/warehouse/castor/pallet/goods) surfaced Tier 2: 9 verified Loading Ramp products (569,574,583,638,640,641,643,707,716) that genuinely support 'Load. Move. Deliver.' via the loading/unloading vector explicitly in scope - vehicles/trailers/trucks loaded and unloaded at a site. Each product's own custom_url resolves to safetysector.com.au (verified per-product, not inferred from the shared-store category, which BigCommerce category ids these ramps sit under - 120/121/122/123/124/125/128/129/145/146/148 - are NOT in SS.config.json's featuredCategoryIds and category 120 is documented there as MIXED with SC; discovery here was by keyword search + per-product URL verification, never by pulling 'the whole category', so no SC contamination). 9+9=18 exactly, no padding, no duplicates, no RDD/SC-only products.
